_note: Groups named 'same: ...' mark cases describing the SAME place; validate.py's describer checker compares their [[SETTING_KIND]] across the group. Other group names are plain banners.
_weak_drift_check: IMPORTANT: for the setting role the automated drift field is [[SETTING_KIND]], which is only interior/exterior -- it will pass trivially for almost any same-place group. The real drift signal is whether [[DEFINITION]] stays stable across a group, and NOTHING automated checks that. Read the DEFINITION lines of every 'same:' group by eye.
_v1_result: Confirmed in the v1 round (archived REF2VA/Describer-Setting-v1): all six 'same:' groups passed the automated [[SETTING_KIND]] check while the city day/night pair's [[DEFINITION]] lines shared only one of four items. The automated check is near-worthless for this role on its own. v1's failure mode was that the model described FORMS by day and LIGHTS by night; v2 added a name-the-form rule and an explicit day-and-night test to fix it.
_no_subject_not_found: The setting role has NO [[SUBJECT NOT FOUND]] line, unlike character -- emitting one is an error. Across v1/v2/v3 that single optional line caused EVERY format failure (1, then 5, then 3 cases, all with confabulated subjects such as 'the girl'), and in v3 it was 0-for-2 on the cases it existed to serve: it fired on set_p6_outside where the named view IS visible, and stayed silent on set_notfound where the beach is absent. A setting image has one place the camera is standing in, so there is nothing to disambiguate. set_p6_outside and set_notfound are retained as cases: both must now simply describe the room, with no tail line at all.
_atmosphere_quarantine: The design decision under test: light/time/weather live in [[ATMOSPHERE]] only, and [[DEFINITION]] may never draw on them, so the spliced subject-definition sentence holds by day and by night. 'same: city skyline' is the direct test (one skyline, daylight vs blue hour). CONFOUND: that skyline carries rooftop brand signage which the night frame lights up and the day frame hides, so a DEFINITION disagreement there has two possible causes -- atmosphere leaking, or a sign becoming readable. Separate those before scoring it. 'same: apartment room p1' is a secondary probe (same room, big exposure change, no signage).
_negative_control: classroom1 vs classroom2 are DIFFERENT rooms of the same type, deliberately NOT in a 'same:' group. They must not collapse into interchangeable records.
